propositions: The review-bot webhook and rerun endpoints accept an authentication token as a query parameter, which uvicorn's default access log records in plaintext to stderr and journald.
The webhook_token configuration falls back to GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN, making the exposed query parameter equivalent to the bot's Gerrit credential.
A token leaked into journald is discoverable by operators grepping logs or sharing excerpts, and cannot be retroactively unexposed after rotation without the code fix.

The fix moves token authentication from query parameters to the X-Rebar-Token HTTP header (which access logs do not record) for both endpoints, with a fallback TokenRedactingFilter that scrubs token values from any residual request line.
The previously exposed GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN has been rotated and attested as compromised and purged, tracked separately in rotation ticket 43ea-3d5a-078f-4fe3.
The access log redaction preserves route and status information for observability while removing credential data.
